queries.tags: SELECT t.Id, t.tag_number, t.status, t.description, DATE(t.tag_date) AS tag_date, t.IsPremium, t.JobName, t.CustomerID, t.PMEmail, t.JobNo, t.JobAddress AS Address, DATE(t.LastModifiedDate) AS LastModifiedDate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tag_labor tl WHERE tl.tag_id = t.Id) AS labor_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tag_materials tm WHERE tm.tag_id = t.Id) AS material_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tag_equipment te WHERE te.tag_id = t.Id) AS equipment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tag_other_expenses toe WHERE toe.tag_id = t.Id) AS expense_count FROM tags t ORDER BY t.LastModifiedDate DESC
queries.tag: SELECT t.Id, t.tag_number, t.status, t.description, DATE(t.tag_date) AS tag_date, t.IsPremium, t.JobName, t.CustomerID, t.PMEmail, t.JobNo, t.JobAddress AS Address, t.CreatedById, DATE(t.LastModifiedDate) AS LastModifiedDate FROM tags t WHERE t.Id = {tagId}
queries.newTagId: SELECT MAX(Id) AS Id FROM tags WHERE JobNo = {jobNo} AND CreatedById = {createdBy}
queries.tagLabor: SELECT tl.Id, tl.employee_id, tl.trade_id, TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(tr.TradeName, ':', 1)) AS TradeName, COALESCE(CONCAT(e.First, ' ', e.Last), tl.employee_name) AS employee_name, tl.regularhours, tl.overtime, tl.doubletime FROM tag_labor tl LEFT JOIN trade tr ON tl.trade_id = tr.Id LEFT JOIN employees e ON tl.employee_id = e.Id WHERE tl.tag_id = {tagId}
queries.tagMaterials: SELECT tm.Id, tm.material_id, tm.tag_id, tm.qty, tm.length, tmm.description FROM tag_materials tm JOIN materials_master tmm ON tm.material_id = tmm.Id WHERE tm.tag_id = {tagId}
queries.tagEquipment: SELECT te.Id, te.qty, te.equipment_id, te.tag_id, em.description FROM tag_equipment te JOIN equipment_master em ON te.equipment_id = em.Id WHERE te.tag_id = {tagId}
queries.tagExpenses: SELECT toe.Id, toe.expenses_description, toe.qty, toe.expenses_id, em.description AS expense_type_description, em.CostCodeID FROM tag_other_expenses toe LEFT JOIN expenses_master em ON toe.expenses_id = em.Id WHERE toe.tag_id = {tagId}
queries.employees: select Id,Employee,CONCAT(first, ' ', last) AS EmployeeName,Status,FEID,Division from employees where status='Active Status'
queries.trades: SELECT MIN(Id) AS Id, TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(TradeName, ':', 1)) AS TradeName FROM trade WHERE Category = 'CHANGE ORDER' GROUP BY TradeCode, TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(TradeName, ':', 1)) ORDER BY MIN(Id)
queries.division: select Division from employees where EMPLOYEE = {employee}
queries.approvers: select CONCAT(cc.firstname, ' ', cc.lastname) AS fullname, cc.Id, cc.firstname, cc.lastname, cc.Email, cc.customerID, c.CustomerName FROM customercontact cc JOIN customer c ON cc.customerID = c.CustomerID WHERE cc.customerID = {customerId}
queries.customerName: select CustomerName from customer where CustomerID = {customerId}
queries.submitJob: select *, c.CustomerName from job j JOIN customer c ON j.CustomerID = c.CustomerID where j.JobNo = {jobNo}
queries.submitLabor: SELECT tl.employee_name AS EmployeeName, TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TradeName, ':', 1)) AS TradeName, CASE WHEN {premium} = 0 THEN SUM(COALESCE(tl.regularhours, 0)) ELSE NULL END AS ST, CASE WHEN {premium} = 0 THEN SUM(COALESCE(tl.overtime, 0)) ELSE NULL END AS OT, CASE WHEN {premium} = 0 THEN SUM(COALESCE(tl.doubletime, 0)) ELSE NULL END AS DT, CASE WHEN {premium} = 1 THEN SUM(COALESCE(tl.overtime, 0)) ELSE NULL END AS POT, CASE WHEN {premium} = 1 THEN SUM(COALESCE(tl.doubletime, 0)) ELSE NULL END AS PDT FROM tag_labor tl INNER JOIN trade t ON t.Id = tl.trade_id WHERE tl.tag_id = {tagId} GROUP BY tl.employee_id, tl.employee_name, tl.trade_id, t.TradeName ORDER BY tl.employee_name, t.TradeName;
queries.submitMaterials: SELECT mm.description AS Description, TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TradeName, ':', 1)) AS Trade, tm.qty AS Qty, tm.length AS Length FROM tag_materials tm INNER JOIN materials_master mm ON mm.Id = tm.material_id LEFT JOIN trade t ON t.Id = mm.CostCodeID WHERE tm.tag_id = {tagId} ORDER BY mm.description;
queries.submitEquipment: SELECT em.description AS Description, te.qty AS Qty FROM tag_equipment te INNER JOIN equipment_master em ON em.Id = te.equipment_id WHERE te.tag_id = {tagId} ORDER BY em.description;
queries.submitExpenses: SELECT expenses_description AS Description, qty AS Amount FROM tag_other_expenses WHERE tag_id = {tagId} ORDER BY expenses_description;
queries.submitPhotos: SELECT photo_url FROM tag_photos WHERE tag_id = {tagId} ORDER BY uploaded_at;
queries.tagPhotos: SELECT tp.Id, tp.photo_url, tp.description, tp.uploaded_at FROM tag_photos tp WHERE tp.tag_id = {tagId} ORDER BY tp.Id
queries.jobDetails: SELECT CustomerID, PMEmail, Address FROM job WHERE JobNo = {jobNo}
queries.jobs: select *, CONCAT(`JobNo`, ' : ',`JobName`) as CJobName from job where CustomerName !='' AND CustomerName is NOT NULL AND Division in ({divisions}) order by Address ASC

writes.comment: POST {tablePath} as form fields. With Id: update that row. Without Id: insert (lines also send tag_id). Field lists come from requests captured from the existing app, including the full new-tag save (lines first, then the tag).

uploads.comment: Files are uploaded to eMachine's cloud-storage service (it stores them in Dropbox and returns the file link); the link is then saved on the tag in tag_photos. {appId} and {user} in pathTemplate are filled in: appId from this file, user = the signed-in user's email. CONFIRM appId (captured from the existing app).

submit.comment: Submit (Sign tab) saves the tag, then sends one JSON document to eMachine's signed-document service, which does everything else (the PDF, the Autodesk Cost change order, the emails). The request carries only the user's email in the instantarusername header.

forma.comment: Before a tag is created for a job, the job must exist as a project in Autodesk Forma. The browser calls Autodesk directly. The Autodesk bearer token is fetched on demand from tokenUrl (public, no login) and renewed when it expires.
